Checking cmd/memos for memopayload runners, migrator runners, and other background workers.

Also checking whether the memopayload runner is invoked only from the CLI.
Searching for memopayload.NewRunner usage in store migrators and upgrade paths.

The server starts background runners in `startBackgroundRunners`.

`startBackgroundRunners` launches the S3 presign runner once on startup and again every 12 hours. `memopayload.Runner` exists but is never started; memo handlers call `RebuildMemoPayload` synchronously instead. Webhook workers are started in `init()` by four goroutines consuming `asyncPostQueue`, triggered when the server imports the webhook package. It is unclear whether these count as background runners.

The SSE hub is event-driven rather than scheduled. Checking whether `internal/scheduler` is used anywhere.
The scheduler package is not imported anywhere outside itself. It is unused infrastructure.

The Scheduler is only used in tests and documentation. It is not started by the server.

Webhook workers start four goroutines at process startup. They trigger via event-driven enqueueing on memo events.

The s3presign runner starts in server.startBackgroundRunners. It runs once immediately and then every twelve hours.

The memopayload runner is not started by the server. Its rebuild logic lives only in request handlers.

The memopayload runner is defined in the codebase but never invoked by the server. The HTTP server goroutine is not treated as a background runner.

The store migrator runs once at startup before the server begins. It does not start a background worker.

Email is handled synchronously on the request path. No background worker runs it.

The server explicitly starts one background runner: s3presign. It triggers once immediately at startup and again on a 12-hour ticker in server/server.go. Webhook workers run via package init when main imports the webhook package. Connect interceptors are not background workers.

The memopayload runner is not started by the server. It only runs synchronously inside request handlers.

The internal/scheduler cron scheduler exists in the codebase but is not imported or used by the server or its command entry point.

Only the s3presign runner is launched by server.Start(). Webhook dispatch workers are started earlier by package init, before main Run, though they still run within the memos process.
